verdict.rationale: Docs confirm fiat off-ramp rails (ACH, Fedwire, Swift, SEPA) and explicit crypto-to-fiat conversion into bank accounts, including auto-convert USDC to USD for treasury (coinbase-payments-docs-2, -14, -19, -23, -30). However, there is no published table of supported countries or local currencies beyond USD/major wire rails, so coverage breadth for 'local fiat across a published set of currencies and countries' is unproven. Missing for 10: a documented list of supported countries/currencies for off-ramp, and confirmation of non-USD local currency payout support.
